slots.part: Enterprise · Reading SharePoint through Microsoft Graph

videos.oembed_title: Delegated and application permissions in the Microsoft Identity Platform
videos.watch_for: Delegated permissions act as the signed-in user and see only what that user sees; application permissions (e.g. Files.Read.All) see everything and need admin consent, which is why an indexer must re-apply user permissions at query time.
videos.why_this_one: Microsoft-run community learning channel; the delegated/application distinction is stable identity-platform behavior.

slots.note: Keep the driveItem children API page as a coding reference (paging with @odata.nextLink); the permissions overview is covered by the video but can stay if the owner prefers.

The best official option, Microsoft Reactor "Data Access Control for AI RAG Apps on Azure" (4PKug91OSw8, Pamela Fox + Azure AI Search PM Matt Gotteiner, 2024-07-17), is a 1-hour livestream with no chapters found. Keep the Azure security-trimming doc as the main item.
